strings.name: Jane Fraser
strings.summary: Born in Scotland, Fraser studied economics at Cambridge and business at Harvard, then became a McKinsey partner. Joining Citi in 2004, she led private banking, Latin America and global consumer banking. In 2021 she became the first woman to lead a major US bank. She pursued simplification, restructuring and regulatory remediation, adding the chairmanship in 2025.
